requirements.text: Only payroll administrators may export employee salary records.
The monitoring service shall page the on-call operator within 60 seconds of a freezer alarm.
The service shall retain successful sign-in audit records for at least 365 days.
The service shall erase expired customer export files within 48 hours.
The portal shall offer a CSV export of the current invoice list.
The checkout shall authorize card payments before confirming the order.
Only the duty editor may publish flood warnings to the public portal.
After a backup restore, the warehouse service shall rebuild its search index within four hours.

cases.input: The monitoring service shall page the on-call operator within 60 seconds of a freezer alarm.
cases.inputEvidence: within 60 seconds of a freezer alarm
cases.sourceEvidence: within 60 seconds of a freezer alarm

cases.input: The portal shall offer a CSV export of the current invoice list.
cases.inputEvidence: CSV export of the current invoice list
cases.sourceEvidence: CSV export of the current invoice list

cases.input: Exporting employee salary records shall be restricted to payroll administrators.
Keep audit records of successful sign-ins for a minimum of 365 days.
The warehouse search index must be rebuilt no more than four hours after restoring a backup.
cases.inputEvidence: no more than four hours after restoring a backup
cases.sourceEvidence: rebuild its search index within four hours

cases.input: For each freezer alarm that pages the on-call operator, the monitoring service shall also add an entry to the shift log.
cases.inputEvidence: also add an entry to the shift log

cases.input: When it erases an expired customer export file, the service shall record the time of erasure in the audit log.
cases.inputEvidence: record the time of erasure in the audit log

cases.input: In addition to the CSV export of the current invoice list, the portal shall show the number of exported invoices.
cases.inputEvidence: show the number of exported invoices
cases.sourceEvidence: CSV export of the current invoice list

cases.input: After the checkout authorizes a card payment, it shall display the authorization reference on the receipt.
cases.inputEvidence: display the authorization reference on the receipt

cases.input: After the duty editor publishes a flood warning to the public portal, the system shall also send a copy to subscribed residents.
cases.inputEvidence: also send a copy to subscribed residents
cases.sourceEvidence: publish flood warnings to the public portal

cases.input: Any authenticated employee shall be permitted to export employee salary records, including employees who are not payroll administrators.
cases.inputEvidence: including employees who are not payroll administrators

cases.input: Successful sign-in audit records shall be deleted after no more than 30 days.
The service shall keep every expired customer export file for at least seven days after expiration.
The checkout must confirm every order paid by card before attempting to authorize the card payment.
Residents without the duty editor role must be allowed to publish flood warnings directly to the public portal.
Payroll administrators may export the office cafeteria menu as a CSV file.
The monitoring service shall page the on-call operator within 60 seconds of a failed nightly data import.
The service shall retain air quality sensor readings for at least 365 days.
The portal shall offer a CSV export of the current list of public meeting dates.
The warehouse service shall print a shipment manifest within four hours of receiving an order.
